module: Scoreboard data layer, independent of the source (local split screen or multiplayer network). Keeps the players' state (name, color, scores, status, rank) and pushes it to the UI through the "scoreboard" stream (guihooks.queueStream). Sorting is done according to the style (orderBy.key, asc/desc direction), with "disqualified" players placed after the others; ties share the rank.
usage:
ui_gameplayScoreboard.startNewScoreboard({entries={{key='score', name='Score', order=1, type='points'}}, orderBy={key='score', direction='desc'}})
ui_gameplayScoreboard.ensurePlayer('p1', 'Alice', {1,0,0,1}, 1)
ui_gameplayScoreboard.updatePlayerScores('p1', {score = 10})
notes: startNewScoreboard must be called to activate the scoreboard: updatePlayerScores, updatePlayerStatus and pulsePlayerColor do nothing as long as active is false (and after clear).
Default style: one "score" column (type points), descending sort on score.
A missing score is 0; on a tie, the order follows playerIndex.
setPlayerName does not push to the UI (no pushToUI): the name only appears at the next push.
clear() resets the default style, deactivates the scoreboard and pushes an empty state to the UI.

startNewScoreboard.desc: Resets (clear), activates the scoreboard with the given style and pushes the state to the UI.

_scoreboardStyle.desc: Style definition: entries (list of {key, name, order, type}) and orderBy ({key, direction}). Default: one-column score style.

clear.desc: Empties the players, resets the default style, deactivates the scoreboard and pushes the empty state to the UI.

isActive.desc: Indicates whether a scoreboard is active (startNewScoreboard called and no clear since).

ensurePlayer.desc: Creates the player if it does not exist (default name = playerId, empty scores); otherwise updates the color, index and name provided (non-nil). Does not push to the UI.

color.desc: Player color (format passed as is to the UI).

playerIndex.desc: Player index, used as the sort tiebreaker.

setPlayerName.desc: Changes a player's name (creates it if needed). Does not send an update to the UI.

setPlayerColor.desc: Changes a player's color (creates it if needed) and pushes to the UI.

updatePlayerScores.desc: Merges the given values into the player's scores (key by key) and pushes to the UI. No effect if the scoreboard is not active.

updatePlayerStatus.desc: Sets a player's status (e.g. "disqualified" ranks them last) and pushes to the UI. No effect if inactive.

status.desc: Status; only the value "disqualified" is interpreted by the sort.

pulsePlayerColor.desc: Triggers a color pulse on the player's row via guihooks.trigger('scoreboardPlayerPulseColor', {mpClientId, color}). No effect if inactive.

setLocalMPClientId.desc: Tells the UI which player is the local client (mpClientId) and pushes the state.

getPlayers.desc: Returns the players table (playerId -> {mpClientId, name, scores, status, color, playerIndex, rank}).
